standards.title: Pick easing by the motion's job
standards.rule: Choose each animation's easing by asking in order whether it enters or exits the screen (ease-out), moves or morphs on screen (ease-in-out), is a hover or color change (ease), or is constant motion such as a spinner, marquee or progress fill (linear), and use ease-out when none applies. Never put linear on an entrance, and put bare ease on one only when the component's personality calls for it, as the toast recipe does (STD-easing-duration-13).
standards.why: Easing is the most important part of any animation; the decision order is strict so the agent does not guess or make up its own rules, and linear is kept for constant motion because progress shouldn't ease.

The Expo skill gives native sheets, modals and drawers a spring of about 300ms perceived. It is the curve Vaul uses; Vaul itself is unmaintained per its README (learn/sources.json), so this rests on the article and skills, not on Vaul as a dependency.

standards.title: Duration budget for each element
